summary: Iran ceasefire optimism pulled oil lower and trimmed rate-hike bets this week, lifting equities to all-time highs and crushing VIX even as core PCE held at 3.3% annually. The Trump-Xi summit trade deals added a second tailwind for stocks, but stubbornly high real rates and a firming dollar continue to weigh on gold and keep crypto without a macro catalyst.
tweet: Iran peace hopes and Trump-Xi trade deals pushed stocks to all-time highs this week, but 3.3% core PCE and elevated real rates keep gold pinned and crypto sidelined.
